whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Smile Care Dental Clinic,

I noticed your dental clinic has a prime location on New Dak Bunglow Rd in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new patient appointments.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, smile makeover services, aur patient reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/smilecare

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Smile Care Dental Clinic team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking and mobile-first speed for patients searching on New Dak Bunglow Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
